Dre’Kaar gives the orders to the Commander Beetle. Put register(), dispatch(orderId), cancel(orderId), and deliver(orderId) on the beetle.
The Commander Beetle stores orders through the Command interface. Its deliver(orderId) method calls execute() without needing to know which receiver does the work.
Each order implements Command and has its own version of execute(). The order uses one receiver: Latve, Faelina, or Narion.
The receivers do the work. Give wakeEveryone() to Latve, setTraps() to Faelina, and holdFlank() to Narion.
